dari-kamar-kos-menjadi-pusat-kebaikan-um.title: More Than Just a Place to Pray
dari-kamar-kos-menjadi-pusat-kebaikan-um.description: Have you ever imagined a single mosque becoming a witness to countless acts of goodness?As the needs of the congregation
dari-kamar-kos-menjadi-pusat-kebaikan-um.body:
Have you ever imagined a single mosque becoming a witness to countless acts of goodness?

As the needs of the congregation continue to grow, God willing, a great endeavor is about to begin: The Wakaf Expansion of Daarut Tauhiid Gegerkalong Mosque.

Before the planned five-story mosque—designed to be senior-friendly, inclusive, and eco-green—can rise, there is one crucial step we must strive for together: acquiring the land for the expansion area.

Why Does This Mosque Expansion Wakaf Matter?

Because every inch of land you dedicate through wakaf can become a seed of everlasting reward.

Our contribution today may seem small. But from that small act, God willing, countless acts of goodness can continue to grow and flow.

Take part in the Wakaf Expansion of Daarut Tauhiid Gegerkalong Mosque.

One Wakaf, Expanding the Space for Goodness.

gajian-makin-berkah-dengan-sedekah.title: Make Your Paycheck Even More Blessed Through Shadaqa
gajian-makin-berkah-dengan-sedekah.description: Every month, Allah entrusts us with sustenance through the salary we receive. There is a sense of relief when our needs
gajian-makin-berkah-dengan-sedekah.body:
Every month, Allah entrusts us with sustenance through the salary we receive. There is a sense of relief when our needs are met, and gratitude when our hard work finally bears fruit. Yet behind that sustenance, there is always room to ask ourselves: has a portion of this trust been channeled back into acts of kindness?

Because a salary isn’t just about the numbers deposited into our bank accounts. It can also bring a smile to the faces of those who are struggling, provide food for the hungry, offer aid to families in remote parts of the country, and even become a source of hope for our brothers and sisters in Gaza, Palestine.

In various corners of the country, there are still our brothers and sisters living with limited means. There are children in need of educational support, underprivileged families waiting for a helping hand, and communities affected by disasters who are trying to get back on their feet. Meanwhile, in Gaza, the wounds and grief are far from over. They need our compassion to keep going.

The charity we set aside from our paychecks may seem modest. Yet, when given with the intention of pleasing Allah, it can become a blessing that extends far and wide: helping those far away, strengthening the weak, and simultaneously purifying and soothing our own hearts.

Let’s make this month’s paycheck not just about meeting our needs, but also about seeking blessings. Set aside the best portion for charity; may Allah make it a path of goodness for our brothers and sisters across the nation, all the way to Gaza, Palestine, and may it become a deed of charity that continues to

beasiswa-peduli-negeri-setiap-anak-berha.title: Peduli Negeri Scholarship: Every Child Deserves Education, Every Dream Must Be Pursued
beasiswa-peduli-negeri-setiap-anak-berha.description: Many orphaned children and dhuafa have great enthusiasm for learning, yet are limited by economic conditions. Yet educat
beasiswa-peduli-negeri-setiap-anak-berha.body:
Many orphaned children and dhuafa have great enthusiasm for learning, yet are limited by economic conditions. Yet education is the key to changing the future and breaking the cycle of poverty.

The Beasiswa Peduli Negeri Program serves as a bridge of goodness for Indonesian children from junior high school to higher education. Through the concept of foster parents, donors can accompany their educational journey so they can continue to learn, grow, and achieve their dreams.

One assistance you provide today can be the first step in the birth of an excellent generation that brings benefits to the nation and the ummah.

Let us be part of their journey towards a better future.

peduli-yatim-palestina.title: Care for Palestinian Orphans
peduli-yatim-palestina.description: Which child would want to grow up amid endless human tragedy? Palestinian children never asked for it, yet they must end
peduli-yatim-palestina.body:
Which child would want to grow up amid endless human tragedy? Palestinian children never asked for it, yet they must endure it without parents, possessions, and certainty. 

Their wounds run too deep, while the world remains silent. Small children on the brink of death not only because of weapons, but also because they have gone hungry for too long. 

This Muharram, we want to bring happiness together to orphaned children and dhuafa in Palestine. We can help them by relieving their hunger or healing their wounds. We help them by providing food and medicine. Insya Allah, every rupiah we donate will not only become hope for them, but also proof that our humanity still exists.

Sahabat Peduli, let us be part of goodness for our Palestinian brothers and sisters!

mengalirkan-kebaikan-sedekah-atas-nama-o.title: Flowing Goodness: sedekah in Honor of Our Parents
mengalirkan-kebaikan-sedekah-atas-nama-o.description: Parents are the gates of paradise that Allah has presented in our lives. Every prayer of theirs accompanies our steps, e
mengalirkan-kebaikan-sedekah-atas-nama-o.body:
Parents are the gates of paradise that Allah has presented in our lives. Every prayer of theirs accompanies our steps, every sacrifice they make shapes who we are today. Therefore, there is no more beautiful way to repay their love than by channeling goodness in their name. Sedekah in the name of parents is a manifestation of devotion that transcends words, a love brought forth in real action, whether they are still with us or have already gone before Him.

In a hadith narrated by Imam Bukhari and Muslim, a companion asked the Prophet ﷺ that his mother had passed away suddenly and he suspected his mother wanted to give sedekah; he then asked whether there would be reward for him if he gave sedekah in the name of his mother. The Prophet ﷺ answered, "Yes." From this, the scholars explain that sedekah intended in the name of parents will, God willing, reach them. Imagine, dear Friend, with just a little from the sustenance you set aside, you are gifting an act of goodness that flows for your beloved Father and Mother.

Every meal for an orphan child, every assistance for dhuafa families, every basic need fulfilled for those in need, all of it becomes a treasure of goodness that you present in the name of your parents. This is the bridge of goodness that connects your devotion with blessings for others, a love that never breaks even as time continues to flow.

Through DT Peduli, you can channel sedekah in the name of your parents as a means to attain His pleasure and blessings. Make sure you flow the best goodness in the name of your parents, and let every act of goodness become a prayer that accompanies them. May Allah accept this deed and make it a witness to a child's love for their parents. Aamiin Ya Rabbal 'Alamin.

pahala-berlipatt-dengan-sedekah-jumat.title: Multiply Your Rewards with Friday sedekah
pahala-berlipatt-dengan-sedekah-jumat.description: Friday is a special day, full of blessings and forgiveness. On this noble day, every good deed we plant will bear fruit
pahala-berlipatt-dengan-sedekah-jumat.body:
Friday is a special day, full of blessings and forgiveness. On this noble day, every good deed we plant will bear fruit with multiplied rewards. Let us make every Friday a momentum to share happiness and lighten the burden of others. Sincere sedekah on Friday not only purifies wealth, but also calms the soul and opens doors to unexpected sustenance from Allah SWT. Truly, there is nothing more joyful than seeing the smile of those helped by our outstretched hand.

Every rupiah you set aside for Friday sedekah is the best investment for the hereafter. Imagine, with just a little of your sustenance, we can together realize the hopes of orphans, help dhuafa families, or provide basic needs for those in need. This is not merely giving, but building a bridge of goodness that connects our hearts with those less fortunate. Let us seize the blessings of Friday by spreading goodness, because every drop of kindness will return to us in a more beautiful form.

Do not miss this golden opportunity to gain abundant rewards on Friday. Let us join in this movement of goodness and feel the invaluable peace of heart. Channel your best sedekah now, and witness how Allah SWT repays every good deed you do with a far better reward. May every step we take in giving become a witness on the day of reckoning, and lead us to His Jannah. Aamiin Ya Rabbal Alamin

wakaf-masjid-5in1-rahmatan-lilalamin.title: Complete the Mosque, Earn Rewards in Paradise
wakaf-masjid-5in1-rahmatan-lilalamin.description: We often seek great deeds, yet the greatest deed might be waiting for us in a place we never expected. It could be that
wakaf-masjid-5in1-rahmatan-lilalamin.body:
We often seek great deeds, yet the greatest deed might be waiting for us in a place we never expected. It could be that deed is a mosque building that has long awaited the final touch from us, so it becomes a fully worthy and vibrant place of worship. 

A mosque is not merely a place to stand, but a place where traces of goodness flow endlessly. There, every servant prostrates, children learn to know and love Allah, and souls thirsty for knowledge gather. There are also travelers seeking shelter and hearts longing for peace. 

Five Mosques That Have Already Come to Life  

Currently there are five mosques waiting for their construction to be completed, namely: 

  • Masjid Rahmatan Lil 'Alamin – Eco Pesantren 2, West Bandung
     

  • Masjid Rahmatan Lil 'Alamin – Eco Pesantren 3, Kuningan 

  • Masjid Rahmatan Lil 'Alamin – Jambi 

  • Masjid Rahmatan Lil 'Alamin – Lubuklinggau 

  • Masjid Rahmatan Lil 'Alamin – Batam 

Although construction progress was temporarily halted, its primary function is already alive and felt by students and the community. This is proof that wakaf does not wait for buildings to be completed to provide benefit. 

In Jambi, the half-finished mosque has become a center of community activities: a place for children's guidance, empowerment, mental development, and a gathering space for active and caring student communities. Similarly, the mosques in Kuningan and Batam have begun to become centers of dakwah movement and religious activities. 

In Lubuklinggau, though not yet perfect, this mosque is already used for prayer, learning, and memorizing the Qur'an. Meanwhile, at Eco Pesantren 2, this mosque has been used for five daily prayers and student study circles—only the facilities and infrastructure remain inadequate.  

Wakaf Friends, Allah sends the opportunity for eternal reward through these nearly completed mosques. This is how Allah eases our steps toward a home in paradise—through one small decision today.  

Perfect the House of Allah, and perfect your path to a home in paradise!

wakaf-bisa-satu-niat-banyak-manfaat.title: One Good Deed Today
wakaf-bisa-satu-niat-banyak-manfaat.description: Through wakaf, every good deed you entrust transforms into endless amal jariyah. Via Wakaf Umum, you help bring to life
wakaf-bisa-satu-niat-banyak-manfaat.body:
Through wakaf, every good deed you entrust transforms into endless amal jariyah. Via Wakaf Umum, you help bring to life various important programs such as the construction of mosques and pesantren, provision of clean water, procurement of Al-Qur'an mushaf, educational support, and the development of productive wakaf whose returns benefit the ummah.

Your single wakaf provides rewards that continue to flow—strengthening places of worship, enlightening generations, revitalizing pesantren, providing water for those in need, and fostering the ummah's economy through productive assets.

Let us realize blessings that extend widely.

Together with Wakaf Umum—One intention, its benefits never cease.

peduli-terdampak-bencana.title: Care for Disaster Survivors
peduli-terdampak-bencana.description: Somewhere in this country, our brothers and sisters have just lost everything.A home built over many years — leveled to
peduli-terdampak-bencana.body:
Somewhere in this country, our brothers and sisters have just lost everything.

A home built over many years — leveled to the ground in minutes. Fields that sustained their families — submerged without a trace. Children who fell asleep in warmth — awakened in panic and biting cold.

Disaster gives no warning. It comes, and leaves deep wounds.

But amid that suffering, Allah SWT does not leave them alone.

Because we are here — a community bound by faith, by ukhuwah, by His command to bear one another's burdens.

"The parable of the believers in their affection, mercy, and compassion for one another is that of a single body. When one limb of the body suffers, the entire body feels the pain." (Narrated by Bukhari & Muslim)

DT Peduli is here, moving swiftly — going directly to disaster sites with comprehensive response measures:

  • 🚨 Emergency aid — logistics, food, clothing, and urgent necessities

  • 🏥 Initial recovery — health services, trauma healing, and shelter supplies

  • 🤝 Ongoing support — accompanying survivors to rise again, slowly but surely

The funds collected will be used for disaster response nationwide — not limited to one region or one type of disaster. Because calamity can strike anywhere, and our compassion knows no bounds.

berbagi-bahagia-bersama-yatim.title: Share Joy with Orphans
berbagi-bahagia-bersama-yatim.description: Orphaned children and dhuafa are a door of goodness that Allah opens for us. They need our attention, love, and support
berbagi-bahagia-bersama-yatim.body:
Orphaned children and dhuafa are a door of goodness that Allah opens for us. They need our attention, love, and support to weave their future.

Through the Sharing Happiness Together with Orphans program, we bring joy to orphaned children and dhuafa through educational activities such as educational tours, education, and various other valuable experiences.


When we bring them happiness, truly Allah SWT is increasing the blessings in our lives.

kirim-bantuan-kemanusiaan-untuk-rakyat-g.title: Send Humanitarian Aid for the People of Gaza
kirim-bantuan-kemanusiaan-untuk-rakyat-g.description: 10 Container trucks of aid packages ready for us to distribute, Insyaa Allah!Your compassion, nurturing hope that never
kirim-bantuan-kemanusiaan-untuk-rakyat-g.body:
10 Container trucks of aid packages ready for us to distribute, Insyaa Allah!

Your compassion, nurturing hope that never fades. On April 11–14, 2026, humanitarian aid will be dispatched again to Gaza, Palestine.

The aid in the form of food necessities, hygiene supplies, and warm blankets is intended to reach tens of thousands of people.

Please pray for the best, so that this aid journey is given ease, safety, and reaches those who desperately need it.

If you want to participate, come on send your best aid with DT Peduli here!

sedekah-daging-lintas-negeri.title: Cross-Border Sedekah Meat Distribution
sedekah-daging-lintas-negeri.description: Every Eid al-Adha, qurban meat is distributed widely around us.Yet at the same time, there are still our brothers and si
sedekah-daging-lintas-negeri.body:
Every Eid al-Adha, qurban meat is distributed widely around us.

Yet at the same time, there are still our brothers and sisters in remote areas across the country and various parts of the world who have not experienced it.

Not because they do not want to, but because access has not yet reached them.

In remote areas, disaster-affected regions, and conflict zones, meat is something very rarely enjoyed—it may even be just a hope that comes every year.

Through Sedekah Daging Lintas Negeri, your qurban does not stop at just one place.

Your kindness will reach further, to the remote corners of Indonesia and more than 30 countries in the world.

Because qurban is not only about worship, but also about bringing happiness and delivering the trust to the right place.

sedekah-daging-ke-pelosok-negeri.title: Sedekah Daging to Remote Areas Across Indonesia
sedekah-daging-ke-pelosok-negeri.description: There are children who grow up without ever truly knowing what it feels like to enjoy meat on a festive day.For them, Id
sedekah-daging-ke-pelosok-negeri.body:
There are children who grow up without ever truly knowing what it feels like to enjoy meat on a festive day.


For them, Idul Adha is not about special dishes, but about a day that passes like any other—with nothing different on the dining table.
There are also families who keep smiling amid their limitations.
They celebrate with what they have—simple side dishes, warm rice, and prayers that never cease. Not because they don't want to experience more, but because circumstances simply haven't allowed for it yet.
Meanwhile, we are still given the opportunity to choose, plan, and even decide where our qurban will be distributed.


At the same time, in places far from reach, there are those who can only wait, hoping that a small portion will arrive, enough to bring simple happiness on this blessed day.
Sometimes, it's not about the size of the gift. But about how our presence—even through an intermediary—can mean so much to those who receive it.


If this year Allah has not made it easy for you to perform qurban, it doesn't mean we've lost the opportunity to share. There is still a wide path of goodness open—through Sedekah Daging Pelosok Negeri.
A simple way to remain part of the joy of Idul Adha, bringing qurban meat to remote areas, to isolated regions, even to the dining tables of families who have only been able to hope.
Imagine, from the sedekah you entrust, there are smiles of children who finally get to taste the deliciousness of meat. There is the emotion of parents who can serve a more worthy meal for their families. There are sincere prayers that may not be heard, but reach the heavens.


Because truly, sharing is not just about giving. It's about strengthening, reviving hope, and bringing happiness to the hearts of others.
Come on, don't let them just wait.
Make your sedekah a path of blessing that truly reaches them.

sedekah-daging-palestina.title: Sedekah Daging for Palestine
sedekah-daging-palestina.description: Amid wounds that have not yet healed in Palestine, there remains a small hope that is still guarded despite the long dar
sedekah-daging-palestina.body:
Amid wounds that have not yet healed in Palestine, there remains a small hope that is still guarded despite the long darkness.

They live amid limitations, amid fear, hunger, and piercing cold. For them, eating is no longer about choice, but about surviving day after day.

Imagine for a moment, while we can enjoy meals in peace, in Palestine there are children who wake up at night, not because of dreams, but because of the sound of explosions that never cease.

"Sedekah Daging for Palestine" is not merely a sharing program, but about bringing care amid sorrow, about sending strength when they are almost exhausted.

Dear friends of care, this is not only about giving, but about making them feel that they are not alone, that there are still those who care, even from afar.

Let us be part of the care that strengthens them to endure. Give sedekah of the best we have, for our brothers and sisters in Palestine. May every drop of goodness from our friends become a witness to deeds that lead to His pleasure.

sedekah.title: Embrace Blessings Through Sedekah
sedekah.description: sedekah holds a very important position in Islam and has benefits that are no joke. So, who are the ones who benefit fro
sedekah.body:
sedekah holds a very important position in Islam and has benefits that are no joke. So, who are the ones who benefit from sedekah?

In Islam, sedekah is not only an act of kindness to fellow humans, but also encompasses our care and responsibility towards all of Allah's creation. If smiling, removing thorns from the road, and caring for the environment are worth sedekah, how much more so is helping to reduce the difficulties of others.

By expanding the meaning of sedekah to rahmatan lil 'alamiin or goodness for all creation, we can contribute to creating a world that is more balanced, just, and harmonious for all of Allah's creatures.

 

And the recipients of sedekah are not limited to improving human welfare. There is the environment that we must keep clean, there are also animals that need our help just to eat and take shelter. There are also trees that must be preserved, air that must be kept clean, soil that must be kept fertile, and nature that must be cared for and protected.

 

This is the true meaning of sedekah. And be assured, the little care we give will be very valuable for the entire universe.

Allah promises multiplied rewards for those who give sedekah. Every good deed not only brings blessings in this world, but also becomes a savings of reward in the hereafter. sedekah becomes a way to obtain His pleasure, open the doors of sustenance, and bring peace of mind.

 

For the recipients of sedekah, this assistance can become a light of hope that changes their lives. Someone experiencing hardship can find relief and new spirit to continue living. sedekah creates real impact, reduces suffering, opens new opportunities, and awakens gratitude in the hearts of those who receive it.

If smiling, removing thorns from the road, and caring for the environment are worth sedekah, how much more so is helping to reduce the difficulties of others?
